name: skills-skills
description: Skills for authoring and optimizing Claude Code SKILLS — the meta-tooling for the skill ecosystem itself. skills-studio (the skill lifecycle: author / edit / optimize, score against the best-practices rubric, the 9-critic adversarial council, behavioral evals, routing corpora), skills-refactor (refactor or split an existing skill), and meta-app-scaffold (scaffold a skill / reference-app foundation). Skills only — no commands, agents, or MCP. Self-contained.
